topic: Fall & Winter Metro Atlanta Home Inspections

posts.copy: When your Georgia due diligence window is only 5 to 7 days, waiting around for a slow solo inspection costs you negotiating time. My partner and I inspect every property together as a two-inspector Certified Master Inspector team starting at $345 ($295 for condos). One of us evaluates the roof, exterior, attic, and crawlspace while the other checks the electrical panel, plumbing, and HVAC. We finish in about two hours, walk your buyers through what really matters in plain English, and deliver the interactive digital report the same evening. Check open times at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/quote or text (678) 480-2110.

Closing on a home built before 1993 in unincorporated DeKalb County? DeKalb Watershed Management requires a signed Low-Flow Plumbing Fixture Certificate of Compliance before they will turn water service on in the buyer's name. We verify all four fixture classes (1.6 GPF toilets, 2.5 GPM showerheads, 2.0 GPM bathroom faucets, and 2.2 GPM kitchen faucets) and sign your official certificate on the spot for a $100 flat fee, either bundled with your home inspection or standalone. Not sure if your address is unincorporated DeKalb? Text the address to (678) 480-2110 or visit https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/service-areas/dekalb-county-compliance.

Once the builder hangs drywall, 80% of a new home's framing, load-bearing studs, PEX plumbing manifolds, and ductwork is hidden for good. Our two-inspector Pre-Drywall Rough-In Inspection starts at $275 (up to 1,500 sq ft; $300 for 1,501-2,500 sq ft) and catches notched joists, missing nail plates, and loose roof flashing while the builder's crew can still fix them easily. Book your pre-drywall or final walkthrough at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/services/pre-drywall-inspection.

posts.copy: If you moved into a brand-new home in Metro Atlanta 10 or 11 months ago, your builder's 1-year workmanship warranty is about to expire. Before that window closes, our two-inspector team evaluates your roof via 4K drone, scans walls and ceilings with calibrated infrared thermal cameras, and checks the foundation, attic, and HVAC (starting at $335). You get a clean, photo-documented punch list to hand straight to your builder so they cover the repairs instead of your wallet. Schedule at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/services/11-month-warranty-inspection.

Nothing stalls a good contract faster than a surprise roof, electrical, or moisture issue popping up on Day 4 of buyer due diligence. Our Pre-Listing Seller Inspection (starting at $365 for single-family homes, $295 for condos) gives listing agents and sellers a complete two-inspector evaluation before the sign goes in the yard. Fix what you choose upfront, price with confidence, and keep your buyer's closing on track. Book online at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/services/pre-listing-inspection or call (678) 480-2110.
